definitions.ratio_to_null: mean over the range's units of (s_fc1 + s_fc2) / 2, divided by the mean over the same units of the null means of (s_fc1 + s_fc2) / 2 (PREREG_NEXT_PHASE.md Section 1)
definitions.twin_fraction_t50: mean over units of the share of hidden units in a 2-cycle of the matched permutation whose twin correlation is at least 0.5 (bottleneck: mean of its two hidden layers)
definitions.tax_mlp: 1 - sum of character-formula free parameters / sum of dense parameters over the range's converted matrices (SwiGLU: both input matrices counted)
definitions.blocks: 1-based units in depth order (block 1 = code index 0)
